visual_inspection.inspected_by: visual worker (image viewer) on this run; the viewer role reviewed all 174 screenshots of the earlier run independently, see independent_review

independent_review.method: Every screenshot read at screen size or stitched at original resolution; long captures read in 1,500 px bands; WCAG contrast measured from pixels in places where dark mode looked weaker than light mode.
independent_review.note: The viewer read the earlier run. Screenshots of this run that show the fixed areas were read again by the visual worker (inspected_files); the viewer has not reread this run.

issues.title: Book entry label had low contrast in dark mode
issues.detail: White #ffffff on #4cc690, 2.14:1. Now #0e1613 (about 8.6:1). Fixed in the previous round; axe color-contrast is clean.

issues.title: Skip link text was unreadable in dark mode on keyboard focus
issues.detail: White on #e8efe9, 1.17:1. Now #0e1613 (about 16:1). Fixed in the previous round.

issues.title: Chosen (active) mark made the field text unreadable in dark mode
issues.detail: In dark mode the active mark kept the light yellow fill (#f2c94c) while the field text stays light (#e8efe9): 1.36:1. The dark block now gives .posting-mark.is-active a dark amber fill (#6b5a17, about 5.8:1) and a 2px yellow ring. Found by the viewer; the earlier automated checks did not measure text over the highlight layer.
issues.location: web/styles.css .posting-mark.is-active, dark block (placed before the existing .posting-mark.is-active::before rule)

issues.title: Counter number badges had white digits on mint in dark mode
issues.detail: The usage-step badges of the empty state (4), the record field badges (3) and the book entry usage steps (3) drew white digits (counter()) on #4cc690, 2.11-2.15:1. They now use #0e1613 (about 8.6:1). The earlier generated-text check skipped counter() content; it now measures it.
issues.location: web/styles.css .easy-steps li::before, .book-entry-steps li::before, .human-review-panel label::before, dark block

issues.title: Selected text in the field had 3.98:1 in dark mode
issues.detail: ::selection used rgba(242,201,76,0.5) over the dark field. The dark block now uses alpha 0.35; measured 5.99:1 (light mode stays 13.14:1).

issues.title: Full-page captures were blank below about y 16,400 px
issues.detail: Reproduced: a full-page capture of the desktop all-open state (1366x24934) differs from scroll-position captures of the same page in 8 of 28 segments, from y 16200 to y 22500; at y 17,100 the full-page image is plain white while the segment shows the question group. This is a Chromium full-page capture limit (texture size about 16,384 px), not a layout defect. The harness now captures any page taller than 15,000 px as one viewport-sized shot per scroll position (338 segments in this run, 0 blank) and checks every segment for blank content.

issues.title: Number badges above consecutive marks overlap the line above
issues.detail: The yellow number badge sits 12px above each mark. When marked expressions are on consecutive lines the badge covers the lower part of the previous line. The field text is drawn above the badge and stays readable at 1x, but badge and bullet glyphs touch.

issues.title: Number badge of a mark just below the visible part of the field shows half
issues.detail: When the field is scrolled so that a marked line is just out of view, its badge (placed above the line) shows as a half-cut yellow chip at the bottom edge of the field.

issues.title: In-result jump bar is cut at the right edge on a 390px screen
issues.detail: In expert mode the sticky bar (표현 검토 후보, 확인되지 않은 항목, 공고별 질문, 검토 기록) shows its third chip cut at the right edge. It scrolls sideways and no visual cue shows that more chips exist.

issues.title: Color transitions of 150-180 ms remain under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
issues.detail: The reduce block disables transitions only on buttons, toast, mode switch, switch input, summary chevrons and the check button. Marks (160 ms background-color), links and some borders keep short color transitions (13 to 18 running transitions right after a step). No transform, position or size animation was running in any of the six reduce scenarios, so content does not move.

issues.title: Editor footer wraps the check button to a second row when the finding stepper appears
issues.detail: At 1366px the char counter, Ctrl+Enter hint and stepper fill the first row and the check button moves down once a result exists; before a result the button sits on the first row at the right. At 390px the stepper and button stack the same way.

issues.title: No in-page color scheme switch
issues.detail: Light and dark follow prefers-color-scheme only, as the 2026-10-18 UX notes state. Both were verified by emulation; there is no toggle to test.

issues.title: Follow-up question list leaves a lone middle dot on its own line at 390 px
issues.detail: Viewer finding, not seen in the segments read in this run; needs app.js rendering change (not in scope).
issues.action: recorded only; app.js is not editable

issues.title: Question card reached through a linked question has no static marker under reduced motion
issues.detail: The flash is only defined for no-preference motion and a pointer-initiated focus shows no ring; on mobile the sticky bar hides the first line of the section title. Needs a behavior and design decision.

issues.title: Selected and unselected mode tab differ by 1.14-1.15:1 in background
issues.detail: The selected tab is told apart mainly by text color. Changing it also changes light mode.

observations: First screen, /book entry, paste, check, marks on the posting, stepper, linked questions, section jump bar, expert view, memo copy, file save, line rewrite, stale banner, re-check with comparison, clear and undo rendered without clipped, overlapped or broken layout in light and dark at 1366, 820 and 390 px in the screenshots that were read.
At 390 px the /book entry keeps the introduction folded and the posting field starts inside the first viewport; at 820 and 1366 px the introduction is open.

One synthetic posting with three flagged expressions was used. Postings with no findings, very long postings, other organization settings and the sample posting button on a real result were not driven through every state.
Chromium headless shell 153 only. No Firefox, WebKit, real iOS Safari or Android Chrome; mobile is viewport plus touch emulation at device scale factor 1.

AI and law-MCP supplement was not exercised: the server had no keys (capability endpoint reports not ready) and the run button was never pressed. Zero non-GET requests is therefore expected and does not test the supplement path.
No screen reader session, no zoom to 200 or 400 percent, no 320 px reflow, no text-spacing override, no forced-colors or high-contrast mode, no print preview.

axe-core cannot decide color-contrast for gradients, background images, overlaps and generated content, and the manual scans do not judge text over background images (427 elements). The scans found the viewer-reported dark-mode problems only after they were extended; other unmeasured combinations may remain. This is not a claim of full WCAG conformance.

Screenshots: the viewer read all 174 images of the earlier run; the visual worker read 55 of 500 images of this run (326 of them scroll-position segments) plus 3 tiles. The viewer has not reread this run.
Clipboard checks used Chromium clipboard permissions on loopback with a CRLF/LF and BOM normalized comparison; pasting into another application was not tested.

The shared PC was under memory pressure from other sessions. The harness waits for 4 GB free before each scenario (1 wait in this run, minimum free memory sampled 3.84 GB).
